outcome: community-acquired urinary tract infection (UTI) caused by extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL)-positive bacteria
cohort: Infants aged < 1 year with first UTI
finding: Maternal use of antibiotics during pregnancy and Klebsiella species infection were significantly associated with ESBL-positive UTIs in infants.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was not significantly different between infants with ESBL-positive and ESBL-negative UTIs.
